title: Pastiera 0.85
highlights: A refreshed tutorial introduces the most important new settings after the upgrade.
QuickLauncher can now be opened from text fields with SYM + Space.
Status bar variation controls are clearer and can hide variations entirely.
App-specific messenger presets support an optional SYM + Enter send shortcut.
Keyboard layout handling is more reliable, including QWERTZ-aware QuickLauncher search.
Suggestion ranking is more typo-tolerant and can learn preferred app launches.
Titan 2 users get guidance for hiding the extra IME caption bar where supported.
Many smaller fixes improve layouts, symbols, navigation, backups, and release stability.
